title: The Reform Implementation
description: The constitution is in force. Now you must govern under it — 35 legislative actions remaining, 12 done, a country watching to see whether the new order works.

title: Budget Allocation — Reform Quarter
description: The constitution's implementation requires funding. Courts need judges. Agencies need staff. The provinces need transitional support. Reform costs money — the kind the treasury doesn't have.

title: Constitutional Court — First Appointments
description: The new Constitutional Court needs judges. Every faction wants its people on the bench. The first appointments will shape jurisprudence for a generation. Choose carefully — they serve for life.

title: The Family — Anchored or Adrift
description: The reckoning happened. The question is what came out of it. Jonas is cooking again. Liora is working on something — she won't say what. Tomas used 'historiography' correctly at breakfast. Something is healing, or something is pretending to.

title: National Address — The Path Forward
description: The country needs to hear from you. Not through Vyktor's briefings or the afternoon editions — directly. The broadcast slot is reserved. The speech is drafted. The question is what tone you strike.
